command: from pathlib import Path; import hashlib,json; root=Path("."); files=sorted((p for p in root.rglob("*") if p.is_file()),key=lambda p:str(p).encode()); rows=[hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()+"  "+str(p)+"\n" for p in files]; actual=hashlib.sha256("".join(rows).encode()).hexdigest(); expected="c69c38f381767a112d0b4d5692548369f65cbf3a73ba198f76f98310894dd4de"; print(json.dumps({"source_files":len(files),"source_tree_sha256":actual,"expected_sha256":expected,"matches":actual==expected},sort_keys=True)); assert actual==expected
